Build a one-time "How did you hear about us?" acquisition survey for Nxeon (Next.js App Router + TS + Prisma + Tailwind). Work ONLY in worktree **/opt/nxeon-wt-heard/** (node_modules + .env symlinked to prod). Absolute paths under that dir; never edit /opt/nxeon. `cd /opt/nxeon-wt-heard` for shell. Run `npx tsc --noEmit` and fix ALL errors. Do NOT build/deploy/restart or run prisma migrate/generate/db push — the schema field is ALREADY added and the client ALREADY regenerated, so `User.heardAboutUs` is available in the Prisma client and typechecks normally.

SCHEMA (done): `User.heardAboutUs String?` — `null` = not yet asked/answered; `"skipped"` = dismissed; any other value = the chosen channel (`"google"`, `"youtube"`, `"instagram"`, `"tiktok"`, `"facebook"`, `"x"`, `"reddit"`, `"friend"`, `"blog"`, or `"other:<free text>"`).

BUILD:
1. SERVER ACTION `setHeardAboutUs(source: string)` (put in an appropriate existing customer actions file, e.g. lib/actions-account.ts): `requireUser` (customer). Validate `source` against the allowed channel keys + `"skipped"` + an `"other:<text>"` shape (trim, cap the free text ~120 chars, strip anything weird). Set `User.heardAboutUs` ONLY IF it is currently null (enforce "asked once" — a second call when already set is a silent no-op, never overwrites). Return `{ ok: true }`.
2. FIRST-LOGIN PROMPT — a client component `HeardAboutUsPrompt` shown when the signed-in customer's `heardAboutUs` is null. A tasteful modal (render via a portal to `document.body` so it overlays correctly — the codebase hit a bug where a non-portaled fixed modal anchored to a transformed ancestor; mirror `components/admin/EmailLogViewer.tsx`'s `createPortal` fix). Heading "How did you hear about us?", a short sub, and selectable options: **Google Search, YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X (Twitter), Reddit, Friend / word of mouth, Blog / article, Other** (Other reveals a small text input). A primary button submits the choice via `setHeardAboutUs`; a quiet "Skip" submits `"skipped"`. After submit/skip it closes and never reappears (the null→value transition gates it). On-brand styling (reuse existing modal/card/button classes). Respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
3. MOUNT IT in `app/dashboard/layout.tsx` alongside the existing `SignupTracker`/`PurchaseTracker`. The layout already resolves `user` (currentUser) and an impersonation flag (`imp`). Render `<HeardAboutUsPrompt />` ONLY when `user.heardAboutUs == null` AND NOT impersonating (`!imp`) — an admin impersonating a customer must never answer the survey for them. Pass whatever minimal prop it needs (it's gated server-side by the null check anyway).
4. ADMIN AGGREGATE — add a "How did you hear about us?" breakdown to the admin audience/analytics page (`app/admin/audience/page.tsx` — check which exists and fits). `groupBy` `heardAboutUs`, exclude `null`, show each channel with count + % of respondents, sorted desc (map the keys to friendly labels; render `other:<text>` grouped under "Other" or list a few). Match the existing admin stat-panel styling.
5. CUSTOMER PROFILE — on `app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx`, show "Heard about us" in the Client-info section (near Location/Joined) with the friendly label (or "—" if null, "Skipped" if skipped). The page already loads the user; add the field to its select if it uses a narrowed select.

CONSTRAINTS: reuse existing action/RBAC + card/modal/button styling + the portal pattern; the survey is asked at most once and never overwrites; tsc clean; no deploy/db. A shared label map (`key → friendly label`) should live in one place used by the prompt, the aggregate, and the profile so they never drift.

RETURN (final text = data, no preamble): (1) files added/changed 1 line each; (2) the action's validation + once-only guard; (3) the prompt's gating (when it shows, how skip works, portal); (4) where it's mounted + the impersonation guard; (5) the admin aggregate + the profile display (+ the shared label map location); (6) how to test (fresh customer sees it once, answer persists, skip persists, admin sees the breakdown + the profile field); (7) risks. Branch wt-heard, commit nothing.

## What was built

**(1) Files added / changed**
- `lib/heard-about.ts` — ADDED. Shared vocabulary: `HEARD_OPTIONS`, `HEARD_LABELS`, `normalizeHeardSource`, `sanitizeHeardOther`, `heardLabel`, `heardBucket`, `HEARD_OTHER_MAX`.
- `lib/actions-account.ts` — CHANGED. New server action `setHeardAboutUs`.
- `components/customer/HeardAboutUsPrompt.tsx` — ADDED. First-login modal (portaled).
- `app/dashboard/layout.tsx` — CHANGED. Mounts the prompt with the null + impersonation gate.
- `app/admin/audience/page.tsx` — CHANGED. Adds the aggregate breakdown card.
- `app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx` — CHANGED. Adds "Heard about us" to Client info.

**(2) Action validation + once-only guard** (`setHeardAboutUs`, lib/actions-account.ts): `requireUser()` (customer). `source` → `normalizeHeardSource`: trims, accepts a bare channel key, `"skipped"`, or `"other:<text>"`; the free text is control-stripped (drops C0/DEL), whitespace-collapsed, and capped at 120 chars; empty "other" degrades to `"other"`; anything unrecognised returns `null` and the action no-ops. Once-only is enforced at the write via `db.user.updateMany({ where: { id, heardAboutUs: null }, data: { heardAboutUs: value } })` — a second call after any value (channel OR skipped) matches zero rows, so it never overwrites. Always returns `{ ok: true }`.

**(3) Prompt gating / skip / portal** (HeardAboutUsPrompt.tsx): mounted only by the layout when the account hasn't answered, so it renders on first login and closes for good. Options come from `HEARD_OPTIONS`; "Other" reveals an `.input` (maxLength 120) and submits `other:<text>`. Submit is disabled until a choice is made (and non-empty text for Other). "Skip" (`.btn-ghost`) submits `"skipped"`. It closes optimistically on submit and never reappears (the null→value transition gates future loads; the write is idempotent so a double-submit is safe). Rendered via `createPortal(..., document.body)` — same fix as EmailLogViewer, so the `fixed` overlay anchors to the viewport, not the Shell's transformed ancestor. Entrance is `motion-safe:animate-panel-in` (respects reduced-motion); `role="dialog"`/`aria-modal`.

**(4) Mount + impersonation guard** (app/dashboard/layout.tsx): rendered next to `SignupTracker`/`PurchaseTracker` as `{!imp && user.heardAboutUs == null && <HeardAboutUsPrompt />}`. `imp` is the layout's existing impersonation flag, so an admin impersonating a customer never sees or answers the survey.

**(5) Admin aggregate + profile + shared map**:
- Aggregate (app/admin/audience/page.tsx): `db.user.groupBy({ by: ["heardAboutUs"], where: { heardAboutUs: { not: null } }, _count: { _all: true } })`; `other:<text>` rows collapse via `heardBucket`; sorted desc; each channel rendered with `heardLabel`, count, and % of respondents (`pct`) on a `MeterBar` inside a `.card`. Empty state when nobody has answered. "Skipped" appears as a neutral-grey row.
- Profile (app/admin/users/[id]/page.tsx): "Heard about us" line added right under Location in Client info, using `heardLabel(user.heardAboutUs, { withOtherText: true })` → "—" when null, "Skipped", "Other — <text>", or the friendly channel label. The page's top-level `findUnique` returns all scalars, so no select change was needed.
- Shared label map lives once in `lib/heard-about.ts`, imported by the prompt, the aggregate, and the profile.

**(6) How to test**
- Fresh customer: sign in as a customer whose `heardAboutUs` is null → modal appears once on any `/dashboard` route.
- Answer persists: pick a channel (or Other + text) → Submit; reload → no modal; DB row set to the key / `other:<text>`.
- Skip persists: click Skip → closes; reload → no modal; value is `"skipped"`.
- Admin sees it: `/admin/audience` → "How did you hear about us?" card shows the breakdown with counts/%; `/admin/users/<id>` Client-info shows the friendly label.
- Impersonation: admin impersonates a null-`heardAboutUs` customer → no modal (guarded by `!imp`).

**(7) Risks / notes**
- The survey shows on *any* first dashboard load, competing with the unverified-email banner and (via `?signup=1`) the signup pixel — all coexist, but a brand-new signup meets the modal immediately; acceptable but worth eyeballing.
- "Skipped" is counted as a respondent (included in the % denominator and shown as its own row). If you'd rather report only positive channels, exclude `"skipped"` from `heardBreakdown`/`heardTotal`.
- The aggregate is all-time (not windowed like the rest of the audience page), by design — noted in the card subtext.
- Only the `null → value` write is guarded; there is intentionally no path to re-ask or edit an answer later.
- No build/deploy/migrate was run (per instructions); the client already has the field, confirmed in `node_modules/.prisma/client`.
